projects.name: Lunnari Digital
projects.tagline: A cinematic landing page for an AI-first software house.
projects.description: The official website of Lunnari Digital, a Brazilian software house that combines product, design, engineering and AI. A scroll-driven, story-first landing page that replaces generic agency promises with proof: real products, a clear process and a guided conversation to start a project. It ships in Portuguese, English and Spanish, in light and dark themes.

features.title: Cinematic scroll story
features.description: A hero video, orbiting moon phases and before/after scenes tell the story as you scroll, with motion tuned to respect reduced-motion preferences.

features.title: AI-guided contact
features.description: Instead of a cold form, a conversational assistant helps visitors describe their project and sends a clean summary straight to the team by email.

features.title: Three languages, two themes
features.description: Portuguese, English and Spanish with locale-aware routing, plus a light and dark theme that follows the system by default.

features.title: Proof over promises
features.description: Real cases and in-house products such as LunnaPay replace the usual list of services and technology logos.

features.title: Built to be found and trusted
features.description: Structured SEO metadata, generated Open Graph images, a consent-aware cookie banner and a privacy policy are part of the base.

architecture.summary: Next.js App Router with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Scroll choreography runs on GSAP and Motion, while next-intl handles the three locales and route prefixes. The contact assistant validates answers with Zod and delivers the summary through Resend. Unit tests run on Vitest and end-to-end plus accessibility checks run on Playwright with axe-core, gated by lint, commitlint and Husky.
build: The page is a single Next.js App Router route rendered per locale. Content lives in typed modules and message files, so the Portuguese, English and Spanish versions share one layout and only the copy changes.

The cinematic feel comes from scroll choreography: GSAP timelines pin the sections, drive the horizontal phases and scrub the before/after cards, while Motion handles small interface transitions. Everything respects reduced-motion.

The contact step is a guided chat rather than a form. Answers are validated with Zod on the server, rate-limited and emailed through Resend, and the whole flow is covered by Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end checks with axe-core for accessibility.

extras.title: Conversational lead capture
extras.body: The contact step is a short guided chat that asks about the project, budget and timing, lets the visitor review and edit the answers, and only then sends them. Answers stay in the browser until submission, the server validates every field and rate-limits abuse, and the team receives a structured summary by email.

extras.title: Design system and brand
extras.body: The brand pairs Anton headlines with Urbanist body text over a violet orbit gradient, in a light and a dark palette driven by CSS variables. The logo, the moon phases and the orbital arc repeat across the hero, the process and the footer so the page feels like one continuous story.

pt.tagline: Uma landing page cinematográfica para uma software house AI-first.
pt.description: O site oficial da Lunnari Digital, software house brasileira que une produto, design, engenharia e IA. Uma landing page guiada pelo scroll que troca promessas genéricas de agência por provas: produtos reais, um processo claro e uma conversa guiada para começar um projeto. Está em português, inglês e espanhol, nos temas claro e escuro.

features.title: História cinematográfica no scroll
features.description: Um vídeo de abertura, fases da lua em órbita e cenas de antes e depois contam a história enquanto você rola, com movimento que respeita a preferência por menos animação.

features.title: Contato guiado por IA
features.description: Em vez de um formulário frio, um assistente conversacional ajuda o visitante a descrever o projeto e envia um resumo limpo direto para o time por e-mail.

features.title: Três idiomas, dois temas
features.description: Português, inglês e espanhol com rotas por idioma, mais tema claro e escuro que segue o sistema por padrão.

features.title: Prova no lugar de promessa
features.description: Cases reais e produtos próprios, como o LunnaPay, no lugar da lista de serviços e logos de tecnologia.

features.title: Feito para ser encontrado e confiável
features.description: Metadados de SEO estruturados, imagens Open Graph geradas, banner de cookies com consentimento e política de privacidade fazem parte da base.

architecture.summary: Next.js App Router com React 19 e Tailwind CSS v4. A coreografia de scroll roda em GSAP e Motion, e o next-intl cuida dos três idiomas e dos prefixos de rota. O assistente de contato valida as respostas com Zod e entrega o resumo pelo Resend. Testes unitários em Vitest e testes ponta a ponta com acessibilidade em Playwright e axe-core, protegidos por lint, commitlint e Husky.
build: A página é uma única rota do App Router renderizada por idioma. O conteúdo vive em módulos tipados e arquivos de mensagens, então as versões em português, inglês e espanhol compartilham um layout e só o texto muda.

O clima cinematográfico vem da coreografia de scroll: timelines do GSAP fixam as seções, conduzem as fases horizontais e controlam os cartões de antes e depois, enquanto o Motion cuida das transições pequenas da interface. Tudo respeita a preferência por menos movimento.

O contato é um chat guiado, não um formulário. As respostas são validadas com Zod no servidor, limitadas por taxa e enviadas por e-mail com o Resend, e todo o fluxo é coberto por testes unitários em Vitest e testes ponta a ponta em Playwright, com axe-core para acessibilidade.

extras.title: Captação de leads por conversa
extras.body: A etapa de contato é um chat curto e guiado que pergunta sobre o projeto, o orçamento e o prazo, deixa o visitante revisar e editar as respostas e só então as envia. As respostas ficam no navegador até o envio, o servidor valida cada campo e limita abusos, e o time recebe um resumo estruturado por e-mail.

extras.title: Design system e marca
extras.body: A marca combina títulos em Anton e texto em Urbanist sobre um gradiente violeta de órbita, em uma paleta clara e outra escura guiadas por variáveis CSS. O logo, as fases da lua e o arco orbital se repetem no hero, no processo e no rodapé, para a página parecer uma história contínua.

projects.name: Tarot Club
projects.tagline: A daily tarot ritual for self-reflection, read on your own phone.
projects.description: Tarot Club is an Android app that turns tarot into a daily ritual of self-knowledge: a mirror to reflect with, never a prediction of the future. Draw the card of the day, run three-card spreads, hear the reading aloud and keep everything in a private journal. The interpretation is written by an AI that runs on the device, so the question and the cards never leave the phone.

features.title: Card of the day
features.description: One card per day with a morning notification, the moon phase of the day and a reveal that can be read upright or reversed.

features.title: Spreads with a question
features.description: Single-card reflection, three cards as past, present and trend or situation, obstacle and advice, and readings for someone else.

features.title: AI that stays on the device
features.description: The interpretation is generated offline by a model downloaded once to the phone, so questions and cards are never sent to a server.

features.title: Journal with history
features.description: Every reading and personal note is saved to a searchable journal with filters by week, month and favorites.

features.title: Your deck, your atmosphere
features.description: Visual themes and card styles such as Rider-Waite-Smith and Tarot de Marseille, with the full 78-card deck or only the 22 major arcana.

features.title: Control over your data
features.description: Export the whole journal as JSON or delete the account and every reading at any time, straight from the settings.

architecture.summary: Native Android app in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Material 3, organized by feature on top of a design system and Gradle convention plugins. Hilt provides dependencies, Navigation 3 handles the flows and Firebase covers authentication, the private journal in Firestore and Remote Config flags. The tarot interpretation runs on the device with LiteRT-LM and ML Kit GenAI, and purchases go through Google Play Billing.
build: The code is split by feature (home, readings, journal, profile, store, onboarding) over a shared design system. Build logic lives in convention plugins, so every module is configured the same way, and there are two flavors, homolog and production, to keep tests away from real data.

Privacy shaped the architecture. The reading is produced by a language model that the app downloads once and runs locally, so the question and the cards stay on the phone. Only the journal is stored in the cloud, scoped to its owner, with export and delete built in.
Unit tests run with Robolectric, MockK and Turbine, screenshots are verified with Roborazzi, and releases ship through a scripted pipeline with a closed testing track on Google Play.

extras.title: On-device interpretation
extras.body: After the first launch the app offers to download an AI model of about 1 GB. From then on every reading is interpreted offline, without sending the question or the cards anywhere. The trade-off is intentional: a bigger first download and a simpler reading than a cloud model in exchange for real privacy, with a clear notice on devices too limited to run it.

extras.title: Reflection, not prediction
extras.body: The whole experience is written as a mirror for reflection. The interface and the AI prompts never predict the future and never give health or financial advice, and the rules of tarot and the FAQ inside the app explain how each spread is meant to be read.

pt.tagline: Um ritual diário de tarô para autoconhecimento, lido no seu próprio celular.
pt.description: O Tarot Club é um app Android que transforma o tarô em um ritual diário de autoconhecimento: um espelho para refletir, nunca uma previsão do futuro. Tire a carta do dia, faça tiragens de três cartas, ouça a leitura em voz alta e guarde tudo em um diário privado. A interpretação é escrita por uma IA que roda no aparelho, então a pergunta e as cartas nunca saem do celular.

features.title: Carta do dia
features.description: Uma carta por dia com notificação matinal, a fase da lua do dia e uma revelação que pode ser lida direta ou invertida.

features.title: Tiragens com pergunta
features.description: Reflexão de uma carta, três cartas como passado, presente e tendência ou situação, obstáculo e conselho, e leituras para outra pessoa.

features.title: IA que fica no aparelho
features.description: A interpretação é gerada offline por um modelo baixado uma vez para o celular, então perguntas e cartas nunca são enviadas a um servidor.

features.title: Diário com histórico
features.description: Cada leitura e nota pessoal vai para um diário com busca e filtros por semana, mês e favoritas.

features.title: Seu baralho, sua atmosfera
features.description: Temas visuais e estilos de carta como Rider-Waite-Smith e Tarot de Marselha, com o baralho completo de 78 cartas ou só os 22 Arcanos Maiores.

features.title: Controle sobre seus dados
features.description: Exporte todo o diário em JSON ou exclua a conta e todas as leituras quando quiser, direto nas configurações.

architecture.summary: App Android nativo em Kotlin com Jetpack Compose e Material 3, organizado por feature sobre um design system e convention plugins do Gradle. O Hilt fornece as dependências, o Navigation 3 cuida dos fluxos e o Firebase cobre autenticação, o diário privado no Firestore e as flags do Remote Config. A interpretação do tarô roda no aparelho com LiteRT-LM e ML Kit GenAI, e as compras passam pelo Google Play Billing.
build: O código é dividido por feature (início, leituras, diário, perfil, loja, onboarding) sobre um design system compartilhado. A lógica de build vive em convention plugins, então todo módulo é configurado do mesmo jeito, e há dois flavors, homolog e production, para manter os testes longe de dados reais.

A privacidade moldou a arquitetura. A leitura é produzida por um modelo de linguagem que o app baixa uma vez e roda localmente, então a pergunta e as cartas ficam no celular. Só o diário fica na nuvem, restrito ao dono, com exportação e exclusão embutidas.
Os testes unitários usam Robolectric, MockK e Turbine, as telas são verificadas com Roborazzi, e as versões saem por um pipeline com script e uma faixa de teste fechado no Google Play.

extras.title: Interpretação no aparelho
extras.body: Depois da primeira abertura, o app oferece baixar um modelo de IA de cerca de 1 GB. A partir daí toda leitura é interpretada offline, sem enviar a pergunta nem as cartas para lugar nenhum. O custo é proposital: um primeiro download maior e uma leitura mais simples que a de um modelo na nuvem, em troca de privacidade real, com aviso claro nos aparelhos limitados demais para rodá-lo.

extras.title: Reflexão, não previsão
extras.body: Toda a experiência é escrita como um espelho para reflexão. A interface e os prompts da IA nunca preveem o futuro e nunca dão conselho de saúde ou finanças, e as regras do tarô e o FAQ dentro do app explicam como ler cada tiragem.

projects.name: Nebula Wallet
projects.tagline: A borderless crypto and fiat wallet built for speed.
projects.description: Nebula Wallet is an Android-first fintech app that lets users hold, swap, and send both fiat and digital assets from a single balance. It settles transfers optimistically on-device and reconciles with the ledger in the background, so the interface never blocks on the network.

features.title: Instant transfers
features.description: Peer-to-peer sends confirm on-device and settle against the ledger asynchronously, so the UI never waits on the network.

features.title: Unified balance
features.description: Fiat and multi-chain crypto holdings are normalized into one spendable balance with live conversion rates.

features.title: Biometric vault
features.description: Private keys live in the Android Keystore and every signing action is gated behind biometric or device-credential auth.

features.title: Spending insights
features.description: On-device categorization turns raw transaction history into weekly cash-flow and budget breakdowns without leaving the phone.

architecture.summary: Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose over a clean-architecture core that isolates domain logic from platform concerns. Room backs an offline-first cache while a WorkManager sync engine reconciles local state with the backend. Ktor handles networking and every release ships through a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

extras.title: Offline-first sync
extras.body: Every write lands in the local Room store first and is mirrored to a durable outbox. A WorkManager job drains that outbox with exponential backoff and conflict resolution, which keeps balances usable on flaky connections and guarantees eventual consistency once the device is back online.

extras.title: Security model
extras.body: Keys are generated in the hardware-backed Keystore and never leave the secure enclave. Sensitive payloads are encrypted at rest with envelope encryption, and every signing operation requires a fresh biometric prompt, so a stolen unlocked phone still cannot move funds.

projects.name: Aurora Fit
projects.tagline: Adaptive workout tracking that learns your rhythm.
projects.description: Aurora Fit is an iOS fitness tracker that plans, records, and adapts strength and cardio sessions in real time. It reads live sensor data from Apple Watch and HealthKit to adjust targets mid-workout, keeping training honest without a coach in the room.

features.title: Live coaching
features.description: Heart-rate and pace streams from Apple Watch adjust rep targets and rest timers on the fly during a session.

features.title: Adaptive plans
features.description: Weekly training blocks recalibrate from recovery and completion data so the next session always matches current fitness.

features.title: HealthKit sync
features.description: Workouts, energy burn, and recovery metrics flow both ways with HealthKit to keep the wider health picture consistent.

features.title: Rich progress views
features.description: Interactive charts surface volume, personal records, and trend lines across any muscle group or time window.

architecture.summary: Written in Swift with a SwiftUI interface driven by the MVVM pattern and Combine pipelines. A companion watchOS target streams sensor data while HealthKit acts as the source of truth for health metrics. Local session state is persisted with SwiftData and validated by an XCTest suite on every CI run.

extras.title: Real-time sensor pipeline
extras.body: The watchOS extension publishes heart-rate and motion samples over WatchConnectivity into a Combine pipeline on the phone. That stream is throttled and smoothed before it feeds the coaching engine, which lets the app react to effort within a second while avoiding jittery target changes from noisy raw readings.

projects.name: Cipher Notes
projects.tagline: End-to-end encrypted notes that sync everywhere.
projects.description: Cipher Notes is a cross-platform note-taking app where every note is encrypted on the device before it ever touches the network. It ships from one shared codebase to Android and iOS, so the security model and editing experience stay identical on both platforms.

features.title: Zero-knowledge encryption
features.description: Notes are encrypted with a key derived from the user's passphrase, so the backend only ever stores ciphertext.

features.title: Conflict-free sync
features.description: A CRDT-based merge engine reconciles edits made offline on multiple devices without ever losing a keystroke.

features.title: Markdown editor
features.description: A live Markdown editor renders formatting inline while keeping the raw source a single tap away.

features.title: Instant search
features.description: A local encrypted index makes full-text search feel instant while keeping note contents off any server.

architecture.summary: Built with React Native and TypeScript on a shared domain layer that runs identically across platforms. Encryption is handled by libsodium bindings before data is persisted to an on-device SQLite store. Sync flows through a thin serverless backend that only ever relays opaque ciphertext.

projects.name: Orbit Tasks
projects.tagline: A calm, keyboard-fast home for everything you have to do.
projects.description: Orbit Tasks is an iOS productivity app that blends tasks, projects, and calendar time into a single planning surface. It focuses on fast capture and gentle scheduling, turning a messy inbox into a realistic plan for the day in a few taps.

features.title: Frictionless capture
features.description: Natural-language input parses dates, projects, and priorities from a single line as you type.

features.title: Time blocking
features.description: Drag any task onto the calendar to reserve focus time, with two-way sync back to the system calendar.

features.title: Smart today view
features.description: A daily agenda ranks tasks by due date, effort, and priority so the most important work surfaces first.

features.title: Recurring workflows
features.description: Flexible repeat rules cover everything from simple dailies to complex nth-weekday schedules.

features.title: Live collaboration
features.description: Shared projects update in real time so teammates always see the same board without manual refreshes.

architecture.summary: A SwiftUI client backed by a TypeScript serverless API deployed on edge functions. Realtime collaboration runs over WebSockets with a Postgres backend, while SwiftData keeps a local mirror for offline planning. The full stack ships through a trunk-based CI/CD pipeline with automated preview builds.

extras.title: Realtime collaboration engine
extras.body: Shared projects are synchronized through an operational-transform layer over WebSockets, with every change stamped and ordered server-side. Clients apply optimistic updates immediately and rebase against the authoritative log when it arrives, so two people editing the same project see a consistent board without stepping on each other.

extras.title: Offline planning
extras.body: SwiftData holds a full local mirror of tasks and schedule, which means capture and planning work with no connection at all. A background reconciler replays queued mutations when connectivity returns and resolves ordering with server timestamps, keeping the offline experience indistinguishable from the online one.

projects.name: Lumen Commerce
projects.tagline: A headless storefront that loads before you blink.
projects.description: Lumen Commerce is a storefront for a modular-lamp brand, built as a statically rendered Next.js site over a headless commerce API. Product pages are pre-rendered and revalidated on stock changes, so browsing never waits on the backend.

features.title: Instant product pages
features.description: Every product page is pre-rendered at build time and revalidated on stock webhooks, so the catalog is served straight from the edge.

features.title: Responsive by default
features.description: One layout system scales from a 375px phone to a 4K monitor without separate mobile templates.

features.title: Cart that survives
features.description: The cart lives in the URL and local storage, so it survives reloads, devices and abandoned sessions.

architecture.summary: Next.js App Router with static generation over a headless commerce API. Server components fetch catalog data at build time; client components handle only cart and checkout.

projects.name: Pulse Care
projects.tagline: Patient monitoring on the phone, care coordination on the web.
projects.description: Pulse Care pairs an Android app that collects vitals and medication check-ins with a web dashboard where clinicians triage who needs attention. Both clients share one Node API and a typed contract, so a change ships to the app and the dashboard together.

features.title: Vitals at a glance
features.description: Heart rate, sleep and steps sync from wearables into a single daily view on the phone.

features.title: Clinician triage
features.description: The web dashboard ranks patients by risk signals so the care team sees who needs a call first.

features.title: One contract, two clients
features.description: A shared OpenAPI schema generates the Kotlin and TypeScript clients, so the app and the dashboard never drift.

architecture.summary: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose app and a Next.js dashboard over a Node/NestJS API with PostgreSQL. A shared OpenAPI contract generates both clients.
